title: ArduinoPath errors database
description: The Coach's plain-English explanations of compiler and upload errors.

kind.description: compile: compiler messages (and the simulator's, which are worded the same); upload: uploader output; runtime: the simulator while running.

pattern.description: A regular expression (matched ignoring capitals). Groups become {1}, {2}... in the text.

hints.description: Up to 3, from a gentle nudge to the answer.

example.description: A real broken sketch whose compiler output must map to this entry (checked in CI).

example_board.description: The board to compile the example for (default uno).

example_output.description: Real output that must map to this entry.
